dossier.summary: Kestrel Dental Group runs 38 dental practices across New England and has bought nine of them since 2024.
dossier.why_now: Closed its ninth practice acquisition in October.

data.headline: A private dinner for finance leaders
data.subline: Six seats, one table, off the record.

featured_guest.name: Helen Strand
featured_guest.role: Former CFO, a national healthcare services group
featured_guest.bio: She led finance through four acquisitions in three years, and will say which integration decisions she would make first.

data.topic: Buying practices without losing the margin: what finance should own on day one, and what to leave to the clinics.
data.topic_note: One question goes around the table once. After that it is open.
data.menu: Three courses from the Gilt Room kitchen, served at the table. Oysters, a roast, a seasonal tart.
data.menu_note: Vegetarian and gluten-free paths on request. The wine pairing is optional.
data.dress_note: Business casual. Coats are taken at the door.
data.why_now: Closed its ninth practice acquisition in October.
data.why_you: Kestrel closed its ninth practice acquisition in October. Two people at this table have done the same in the last year, and will tell you what they would do differently.
